values.eml_summary: Four layers (world state, canonical symbols, executable operations, rendering); natural language is parsed into canonical state and rendered back out, never used as the state itself.
values.eml_summary_zh: 四層結構（世界狀態、canonical 符號、可執行操作、rendering）；自然語言被解析進 canonical state 再 render 出來，永遠不直接當狀態本身。
